description: Öffentlicher Verkehr: Haltekanten (öffentlich) is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Luzern: Dienststelle Verkehr und Infrastruktur. Enthält Angaben zur Barrierefreiheit der Haltekanten von Bushaltestellen des öffentlichen Verkehrs. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Luzern: Dienststelle Verkehr und Infrastruktur. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
